preconditions.expression: isinstance(words, list) and all(isinstance(word, str) for word in words)
preconditions.description: Input is a list of strings.
Each word contains only alphabet characters.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, list) and all(isinstance(count, int) for count in return_value)
postconditions.description: Output is a list of integers.
The output list has the same length as the input list.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= count <= len(word) for count, word in zip(return_value, words))
postconditions.description: Each count is between 0 and the length of the corresponding word.

postconditions.expression: all(count == sum(1 for i, c in enumerate(word.lower(), 1) if ord(c) - ord('a') + 1 == i) for count, word in zip(return_value, words))
postconditions.description: Each count represents the number of letters in the word that occupy their positions in the alphabet.
